data.description: "Rain Without Shelter" tells the journey of a lone figure walking through rain, fully exposed to nature’s forces, embracing both vulnerability and connection to ancestral spirits. Each drop is a reminder of the past, and the earth beneath their feet resonates with life. The elements—fire, water, and wind—speak to the endurance, strength, and wisdom passed down through generations. Through storm and silence, the protagonist feels unity with those who came before, finding empowerment in the raw embrace of nature. By the climax, body, mind, and spirit merge with ancestral energy, the rain becomes both shelter and revelation, revealing the eternal bond between humans and elements.
data.title: Rain Without Shelter

data.description:
Title: Shelter in the Rain | Official Campus Song 
https://youtu.be/c7ORepxf2wo
Description:
☔ "He longs to voice his hidden desire, like a leaf, emotions swirl and conspire." ☔
Presenting "Shelter in the Rain," a campus song. This is a story you already know—the chance encounter under a shared umbrella, the walk through autumn rain, and the words that linger long after the storm has passed.
Born from the quiet corners of our library, the late-night study sessions, and the unexpected connections that define our college years, this song captures the fleeting, fragile beauty of young love. It's about the umbrellas we borrow and the hearts we almost give away.
🎵 Credits:
• Lyrics & Composition: Long Yi
• Arrangement & Production: A Long Yi Production

🌧️ Behind the Song:
"In his mind, a stolen kiss. Morning's grace, a moment of bliss."
What begins as a passing moment in the rain becomes an unforeseen code between two souls. This song is a waltz of longing, a reminder that sometimes the deepest connections are born not from grand gestures, but from the simple act of sharing shelter.

🎧 Listen with headphones for the full rainy atmosphere.

💬 Share your story:
Have you ever found love in an unexpected place on campus? Tell us in the comments below. We'd love to hear about your own "shelter in the rain" moments.
data.title: Shelter in the Rain. ISRC-CB-GWT-26-00076
